title: Best local ai model to generate 3d models using pictures?
author: am__shm
selftext:
Not sure this is the right place to ask or not...  
I am trying to make a 3d model from an image and websites are not free and I can not use paid models right now, so I searched and found plenty free and opensource models to run locally for free. but I do not have proper time. so is there anyone who tried these models recently??

the model will be use for 3d printing and not necessary for game development.

about the hardware I can use for models, I have a asus tuf dash f15 with RTX 3060 mobile (6GB vram).

comments.author: Adventurous-Pool6213
comments.body: I like using [gentube](https://www.gentube.app/p/world-builder?_cid=wb) to make my character art, really like that its free and unlimited

comments.author: EnumeratedArray
comments.body: Hanyuan if you have the hardware

replies.author: am__shm
replies.body:
Oh, thanks.
That was new, i gonna check that. About the hardware, i will test it on my laptop (3060 mobile with 6GB vram) at the first place then i will borrow some upgraded ones if needed.

replies.author: EnumeratedArray
replies.body: You'll probably need an upgraded one, I think it needs at least 16GB ram and 8gb vram for the lightest model

comments.author: Objects908
comments.body: Trellis.2 supports up to four input images. But you'll have to refine them yourself, for example in Blender.

replies.author: am__shm
replies.body:
Hmmm, i will definitely check it out. I asked the question in other platforms too and they suggested me the same model…

Thanks<3

comments.author: DaedalusRaistlin
comments.body:
You might not have the greatest luck with 6Gb vram. I've been using an 8Gb 3060 Ti, and a fork of Trellis2 that's made for 8Gb. The results are passable for models that don't have fine details. Small things like antennas can go really funky. 

You might have more like with online AI modelling services like Tripo, or setting up a project that uses model generation APIs. I even considered renting some RTX6000s on Google's Cloud Run, but the costs for that are higher than using an Api.

replies.author: am__shm
replies.body:
Hmmm, i see. I think could be able to borrow a friend’s 8GB RTX 5060 :D
That is gonna be helpful since another person suggested trellis2…

About the renting, i am running away from paying anything rn and that is going to be even more scary to me lol.

Thanks anyway I will check the trellis2 and its forks for any suitable replica for my hardware at the first place, then i will borrow some hardware for couple of days.
